objective: Phase 2H: Comprehensive Automated Testing & Verification of Phase 2 Business Management (Repayment Plans, Instalments, Budgets, Reports, In-App Reminders, Forecast/Dashboard Integration, and Zero Regression on Phase 1)
acceptance_criteria: Repayment Plans: Creation of full_payment and instalment schedules, validation of planned amount against unallocated customer credit balance, date ordering
Instalment Tracking & Payments: Recording partial and full payments against instalments, idempotent duplicate payment prevention, updating plan status, customer ledger, and cashbook exactly once
Overdue & Status Derivation: Overdue status derived on read from due date and remaining amount; cancelled plans require reason and record audit event; cancelled/completed plans reject new payments
Budget Management: Category budgets, 75%, 90%, 100% threshold triggers, spent/remaining calculations, excluding supplier bills from expenses
Summary Reports: Server-side calculation of cash inflows, outflows, categorized expenses, customer receivables, supplier payables, and budget utilization
In-App Reminders: Generating reminders for due instalments and bills, deduplication by type/source/date, acknowledgement lifecycle
Dashboard & Forecast Integration: Exposing next instalments due, overdue plan counts, budget alerts, and forecast scheduling without double-counting
Full End-to-End Walkthrough of Phase 2 verifying complete Definition of Done
Zero regression on Phase 1 (all 32 Phase 1 tests pass)
Frontend production build compiles cleanly with zero TypeScript errors
non_goals: No real lending, loan origination, or interest charging
